headline: SLOP WATCH ISSUED FOR THE LINKEDIN PLATEAU AS RESIDENTS RECEIVE THEIR FIRST STORM SIREN AND A SINGLE REPORTING BUTTON IS DEPLOYED AGAINST A CONTINENT OF SYNTHETIC PROFESSIONAL PROSE
advisory: For the first time in the record, residents of the LinkedIn Plateau have been issued a warning device: a button permitting them to flag AI-generated slop where it accumulates. The Service classifies this as a favorable but modest development, roughly equivalent to handing a bucket to a floodplain. Conditions remain wet. Point the bucket downhill and report the nearest drifting broetry to your local moderation authority.

regional_outlook.conditions: Newly installed warning sirens now sound across the plateau, though early tests indicate the volume of synthetic thought-leadership continues to exceed the number of hands available to press the button. Scattered accountability, warming into optimism by afternoon.

Organized synthetic-persona systems intensify as coordinated influence fronts adopt cheap generative labor to multiply their output. Residents advised that any account posting forty identical opinions per minute is not, in the meteorological sense, a person.

Recommendation currents continue to funnel roughly one in two clips toward machine-assembled brainrot. Standing advisory to keep both thumbs dry and scroll with the current only when strictly necessary.
Long-form synthetic sediment now exceeds half the visible seabed, burying answers under drifting filler. Visibility poor; the first real result remains somewhere below the fold.
Automated outreach continues to arrive in polite, personalized-seeming waves that were personalized by nobody. Tides gentle, sincerity absent.

specimen.status: Abundant; nesting in every caption, comment, and closing paragraph on the plateau.
specimen.habitat: Thrives at the end of motivational posts, product blurbs, and any sentence attempting to sound profound at no additional cost.
specimen.field_marks: Recognized by its signature two-beat cadence — 'It's not just X. It's Y.' — repeated until X and Y lose all meaning. Frequently travels in flocks of three, escalating from noun to verb to abstract feeling.
specimen.call: It's not just a spreadsheet. It's a story. It's not just a story — it's a mindset.
specimen.confusion_species: May resemble a genuine rhetorical flourish written by a thoughtful human. Distinguish by removing the antithesis entirely: if the sentence loses no information, it was never carrying any.

spotter_tip: To test any post for the False Antithesis, delete the phrase before the em dash. If the remaining half still says the same nothing, you have positively identified the specimen — and yes, the Service is aware it, too, has a fondness for the em dash.
tomorrow: Reporting winds strengthen on the plateau; expect light accountability with a persistent synthetic haze lingering through Monday.

confirmed_sighting.report: LinkedIn has rolled out a feature allowing users to flag AI-generated 'slop' posts, reflecting growing platform-level pushback against low-quality automated content on professional feeds. The Service welcomes the button and notes, for the record, that a warning device is not the same as fair weather.
